releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.209: Favourite Notes widget now opens the filtered Favourite Notes list instead of auto-opening a different recently edited note. Existing notes, photos, PINs, locks, widget shortcuts, settings, and other features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 377: Favourite Notes opens the selected favourite note in read-only mode first, with Edit Note available. Quick Note and New Note shortcuts removed from Widget Settings. Existing notes and saved data are preserved.
